voxel-to-mesh | Converts voxel array to webgl mesh data
Voxel-to-mesh utilizes a basic culling technique where any shared faces between voxels are pruned from the mesh. Furthermore, the vertices of these now unconnected lips are consolidated to remove T-junctions.
